name: 0.47.05-r8
body:
A simple ready-to-play pack for Linux that includes:
- Dwarf Fortress v0.47.05
- DFHack + TwbT v0.47.05-r8
- compatible DFGraphics tilesets: Spacefox, Ironhand, Phoebus, ...
- Dwarf Therapist v41.2.4
- Legends Browser (legacy) v1.19.2
- Legends Browser 2 v2.0.2
- Announcement Window v1.3.0
- SoundSense RS v1.5.1

name: LinuxDwarfPack-0.47.04-r3
body:
A simple ready-to-play pack for Linux that includes:
- DwarfFortress 0.47.04
- DFHack 0.47.04-r2 + TwbT
- compatible DFGraphics tilesets: Spacefox, Ironhand, Phoebus, ...
- Dwarf Therapist v41.1.7
- Legends Browser v1.19.2
- Announcement Window v1.3.0

Ubuntu/Debian, Arch, Fedora/Redhat:
- install the deb, pkg.xz or rpm package (depending on your distribution)  
or:
- use the AppImage package, after installing dependencies listed [here](https://github.com/McArcady/lnp-forge/wiki/Installing-LinuxDwarfPack-dependencies)

name: LinuxDwarfPack-0.47.04-r2
body:
A simple ready-to-play pack for Linux that includes:
- DwarfFortress 0.47.04
- DFHack 0.47.04-r1 + TwbT
- Dwarf Therapist v41.1.6
- Legends Browser v1.19 (improved world map!)
- compatible DFGraphics tilesets: Spacefox, Ironhand, Phoebus, Vettlingr, Meph ...

Unpack with:
$ tar xjf LinuxDwarfPack-0.47.04-r2.tar.bz2
and start with:
$ LinuxDwarfPack-0.47.04-r2/startlnp.sh
